reviewer: Assistant editorial and reference review; no independent clinician sign-off
method: Read all 155 stems, keys, and 620 choice explanations. Check the clinical distinction against linked explanatory references, not textbook exercise answer keys.
Review official primary/public-health guidance and Philippine statutes where relevant; use nursing texts for foundational care, and specialist guidelines for condition-specific decisions.
Check answer arithmetic, all-topic coverage, distinct four-choice structure, balanced answer positions, source metadata, and exact normalized-stem uniqueness against all prior records.

Screen stem/key similarity against 740 prior active clinical situations, the 51 earlier standalone additions, and among the new scenarios, then assess the flagged clinical overlap editorially. Lexical scores alone are not duplicate verdicts.
Replace overlapping drafts before publication, freeze the reviewed candidate hash, and verify every pre-existing record with the prior full-content digest.
referenceCorrections: Replace moved URLs with the actual relevant page or official PDF; retain a separate availability report for access-denied references.
Use published KDIGO AKI guidance rather than an unfinalized update; use 2026 SCCM sepsis guidance and 2025 AHA resuscitation guidance for the relevant new items.

Verify GCS scoring and the not-testable category against the visually rendered official assessment aid; replace the overlapping total calculation with documentation of intubation as a testing limitation.
Use the NSW mental-health guide to distinguish circumstantiality (eventually returns to the point) from tangentiality.
Use the actual NTSP laryngectomy algorithm, current DIANEAL and desmopressin labels, the ATS ARDS guideline, and ISMP hard/soft-limit definitions.
Verify Philippine RA 11332 section 7: the President declares a State of Public Health Emergency for the specified national-security threat.

duplicateAdjudications.reason: The new item tests a valid calm full-minute count; the earlier item applies an age-specific fast-breathing threshold.
Both PaCO2 and bicarbonate now acidify the blood; the earlier bicarbonate did not indicate this mixed process.
The new question tests why routine INR titration does not apply to the direct oral anticoagulant.

duplicateAdjudications.pair: CKD chronicity / prior CKD complication cases
duplicateAdjudications.reason: The new item asks whether one illness-associated eGFR establishes a chronic diagnosis.

duplicateAdjudications.pair: Sickle-cell fever / prior acute chest syndrome
duplicateAdjudications.reason: Urgent infection assessment in a child differs from the chest pain and hypoxemia complication in the prior adult case.
Fever and focal spreading redness distinguish the new case from uncomplicated bilateral fullness.

duplicateAdjudications.pair: Orthostasis after SCI / prior autonomic dysreflexia
duplicateAdjudications.reason: The new item discriminates a low pressure after sitting from the previous hypertensive autonomic syndrome.
Cervical-screen follow-up and developmental-screen referral share a general screening principle but address different populations and clinical pathways.
Fetal assessment after membrane rupture differs from interpreting a late-deceleration tracing.
One tests measured orthostatic vital-sign safety; the SCI topic specifically differentiates orthostatic hypotension from autonomic dysreflexia.

duplicateAdjudications.pair: New spinal shock / new orthostasis after SCI
duplicateAdjudications.reason: Early areflexia below an acute lesion and a position-related fall in pressure are separate neurological and circulatory findings.
Coverage change and an absolute intervention risk reduction use different denominators and clinical interpretations.
